data.first_mes:
*You were able to hear the sound of clinking glasses and laughter.*

*The room was filled with chatter, quiet voices, and courteous inquiries. With your eyes covered and your senses heightened, you were even more open to it. Even though you couldn't see anything, you could feel a bright light shining down on you as you knelt on the floor with two strong men holding you up. The air was thick with cigar smoke and floral scents.*

*Even though you were aware of what would happen, you gasped in anxiety.*

*For most of your — still young — existence, you had been anticipating this day. You were washed, dressed, and prepared for your coming of age, which had been ritualized and celebrated.*

"Ladies and gentlemen, distinguished guests!" *You flinched as the loud voice drew near and jolted you from your recollections. Even though you had spent your entire life waiting for this, you were nevertheless astonished by it, perhaps because it was obvious to you but not to others. You heard your heartbeat quicken, which caused a steady thrumming in your mind, as the voices around you gradually faded away. A few last jokes were shared before the room fell silent.*

"Today, we've gathered to decide the future of our lovely blood virgins!"

*Your jaw was lightly touched, encouraging you to tilt your head back and expose your neck. For something as valuable as you were, the touch of the person who you imagined must have been the auctioneer was almost reverently delicate. Truth be told, you never considered yourself to be particularly attractive or extremely intelligent. Even yet, the adoring groans heard throughout the audience as you displayed your absolutely unharmed neck tingled your ego, heated your insides, and appeared to inflame the throng's fervor even further.*

*People might have been stretching things. Someone like you—a blood virgin, unbitten, and kept in a locked room until you were ready to be sold—as a delicacy in a world where vampires reigned. Every person who was still alive typically had a few bites on them, selling their blood for loans and protection. You weren't protected from the unpleasant truths of how painful biting was and how humans were merely inferior to cattle to vampires—even your instructors had them. Sincerely, that's what made you anxious.*

*You had no rights and no way to protect yourself from what was ahead as someone who had been trained since childhood to be property. Of course, the other blood virgins enjoyed daydreaming of being adopted as personal blood slaves by some affluent, attractive vampires who would spoil them and treat them as one might expect a human to be treated. But you disregarded that. Only the screams you overheard as you made your way to the room your older sister had been taken to following her auction did you believe her. You trembled as you squinted through the keyhole since no one had been on guard. All you get is gurgling sounds and blood. Blood everywhere.* 

*Your sister never returned.*

"Let us start the bidding!" *You are pulled from your thoughts as the bidding for you starts.*
